r_definition: Net modeled PnL divided by total initial notional × initial raw stop fraction. Full bust = -0.01/stop R. Split trade statistics aggregate both legs.

execution.intraminute_order: opening gaps first, time limit at its open, pending closes; bust-first then stop-first for ambiguous OHLC

execution.drawdown: Realized trade-aggregate PnL at final-leg close, simultaneous exits BTC then ETH. Separate one-minute net-close paths credit partial exits at their actual modeled minute and mark surviving legs; intraminute extrema unavailable.

exact_rules.confirmation: Completed signal bar i; enter at the next one-minute open at the signal bar start timestamp plus its full timeframe. Never enter within signal bar.
exact_rules.exit_rules: After a completed one-minute close reaches +1 initial stop, raise the stop to entry from the next minute. Never lower it. No trailing or partial exits.
exact_rules.time_stop: Entry minute is holding minute 1; if still open after TTL complete one-minute candles, exit at minute entry+TTL open.
exact_rules.filters: Monday-Friday, entry UTC hour 08 through 11 inclusive. playbook.status: Unvalidated harm-minimizing policy for mandatory 100x trading; caps/vetoes below were not backtested as a combined portfolio.
stop_conditions: Daily or weekly loss cap reached
Any unexpected bust or close rejection: halt and audit before further entries
Observed basis/latency exceeds stressed assumptions, or stale candles/BBO
Payout parameters, displayed bust distance, relayer access, retirement or queue/cash status cannot be verified
20-trade rolling mean net R below -0.10, or 50-trade mean <=0: pause for fresh prospective review; these are policy thresholds, not validated tests
playbook.sizing: 0.10% total initial spendable cash equity as isolated margin, split 50/50 only for dual-position exits. Both assets use 100x. Never upscale to satisfy venue minimums; skip if below them.
